title: CIA telepathy drawing tests at SRI
summary: Uri Geller tells of CIA telepathy drawing tests at SRI, about 1970s at Stanford Research Institute, Menlo Park, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Stanford Research Institute, Palo Alto; Langley, Virginia

tellings.quote: So the CIA took me to Stanford Research Institute. drawings were done miles away and I had to receive those drawings telepathically.

plain: Uri Geller, a performer famous for claiming psychic powers, told podcast host Jesse Michels that in the 1970s the CIA, the US foreign spy agency, took him to the Stanford Research Institute, a research lab in California. He says people there made drawings miles away and he had to pick them up with his mind, by telepathy. If true, it would mean the US government was quietly testing whether people could read minds at a distance.
